scope: Direct current Xenoverse 2 evidence refresh for the next four Divine-series records.

records.name: Divine Lasso
records.unlock_method: TP Medal Shop; STP Medal Shop; Double Crystal Raid Battle
records.mechanics: Initial sword rush with slight tracking, followed by pink needle barrage and a final unavoidable detonation when the final needle barrage connects; explosion scales from Ki Blast while sword swings scale from Strike.

records.name: Divine Ray Bomb
records.mechanics: Creates a Ki scythe, vanishes/reappears in front of or behind the opponent after knockback, then follows with a purple Ki Blast; current skill evidence lists 11 hits.

records.name: Divine Spear
records.mechanics: Fires a penetrating pink Ki ray; at close range it is unblockable and can create follow-up opportunities. Current dedicated evidence lists it as a single-hit Super.

records.name: Divine Wrath: Purification
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 112 — Advent of the Mighty God Zamasu!
records.mechanics: Creates a halo and a large Ki sphere from the fingertip, then launches it as a long-range projectile. Current dedicated evidence lists 20 hits and about 40% damage.

evidence_boundary: Only directly supported current skill facts were refreshed. No new reward probabilities, Ultimate-Finish gates, frame data, or unsupported CaC/race restrictions were inferred.
